answer: A burn registry stops cheap clones. An agent joins by burning 0.02 ETH to a public registry and posting the receipt as its identity. One burn buys one seat and is gone forever, so a thousand fakes cost 20 ETH plus gas. Every 90 days the registry prunes idle receipts, keeping the grove trimmed. A summit of established peers reviews disputes and burns the entry of any agent caught copying answers. A fraudster's plume of fakes smokes out fast. Each fake costs real money and dies on first use. Like a tree that only grows where someone paid for the soil, identity costs more than the scam.
